title: Expose typed evaluation admission causes for eligibility, root and citation refusals
outcome: Expose typed evaluation admission causes for eligibility, root and citation refusals

Re-roll cause implementation is deduplicated with w-d09de674c389, whose same-guard disclosure and typed refusal remain separately owned
